title: Multiplicativity of the root-of-unity embedding
statement:
Fix a positive integer $k$ and let $\omega_k = e^{2\pi i / k}$. For $b \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$, write $\lfloor b\rfloor \in \{0,\ldots,k-1\}$ for its canonical representative and set $\chi(b) = \omega_k^{\lfloor b\rfloor}$. Then for all $j, a \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$,
\[
  \chi(j \cdot a) = \bigl(\omega_k^{\lfloor j\rfloor}\bigr)^{\lfloor a\rfloor}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: k is a positive integer (NeZero k)
j is an element of Z/kZ
a is an element of Z/kZ
